verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a review queue, a review-approval API endpoint, early fraud warnings, custom rules and value lists. None of it states that review decisions or confirmed fraud outcomes are fed back to retrain the Radar model or adjust rules. Approving reviews and maintaining allow/block lists are adjacent manual controls, not a documented learning feedback loop.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, my review decisions and confirmed fraud outcomes feed back into the model and rules, so the system learns from every case we work
